name: AXM Evidence Chain Inspector
actions: inspect a pasted or explicitly selected evidence JSONL segment
verify canonical SHA-256 event hashes and previous-hash links
report line-level integrity anomalies without emitting payloads
summary: Diagnoses evidence-retention JSONL chain failures with line-level, digest-only receipts without repairing or disclosing the evidence.
notes: Read-only inspection only. The tool does not start the Workshop, rewrite or delete segments, recover sessions, expose payloads, grant authority, promote findings or change CANON.
